#Fitted 4 different models on microbial dataset with averaged pearson residuals and computation, along with their standard deviations.

#Each model was fitted with both 1 latent variable and 2 latent variables separately

```{r preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(tidyverse)

data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
Xenv[1:6, ]
Xenv[, 1:3]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```


```{r running gllvm - 1 l.v.}
ite = 10
time = rep(NA, ite)
sspearson_resid = rep(NA, ite)

for (i in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({
    glvm1 = gllvm(microbial[, 1:200], Xenv[, 1:2], num.lv = 1, family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")
  }) 

  time[i] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts = predict(glvm1, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
  
  pearson_resid = (microbial[, 1:200] - pred_counts)/sqrt(pred_counts) 
  sspearson_resid[i] = sum(pearson_resid^2)
}
#ds_residuals = residuals(glvm1)

time
sspearson_resid
c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
c(mean(sspearson_resid), sqrt(var(sspearson_resid)))
```

```{r alternating glms - 1 l.v.}
ite = 10
time = rep(NA, ite)
sspearson_resid = rep(NA, ite)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, ite)

for (k in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # simulating 56 observations for 1 latent variable

  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 4) #preset matrix of coefficients including betas and lambdas, nrow = no. of columns in the responses, no. of columns = beta0, beta1, beta2, lambda
  
  N = 20
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
      glm1 = glm.fit(y = df_noXenv[, i], x = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), intercept = TRUE, family=poisson(link='log')) 
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(glm1$coefficients) #1 x 4
    }
    
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4] #200 x 1
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
      glm1 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ]) #invalid type without as.numeric
      new_u[i] = glm1$coefficients 
    }
    
    u = new_u #56 x 1
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }}) 
  
  ite_converge_all[k] = j
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts = exp(eta)
  
  pearson_resid = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts)/sqrt(pred_counts) 
  sspearson_resid[k] = sum(pearson_resid^2)
}

time
sspearson_resid
ite_converge_all

c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
c(mean(sspearson_resid), sqrt(var(sspearson_resid)))

#AROUND 2X FASTER USING GLM.FIT VS GLM
```


```{r alternating glms - 2 l.v.}
library(MASS)
ite = 10
time = rep(NA, ite)
sspearson_resid = rep(NA, ite)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, ite)

for (k in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)) # generate 56 'observations' involving 2 latent variables
  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[1:200]), ncol = 5) #5 to account for 2 l.v and 3 betas
  
  N = 100
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
      glm2 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[, i]), x = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'))
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(glm2$coefficients) #1 x 5
    }
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4:5] #200 x 2, 2 col. now
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 2) #56 x 2, 2 col. now
  
    for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
      glm2 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ])
      new_u[i, ] = t(glm2$coefficients) #1 x 2
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 2, 2 col. now
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }})

  ite_converge_all[k] = j
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts = exp(eta)
  
  pearson_resid = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts)/sqrt(pred_counts) 
  sspearson_resid[k] = sum(pearson_resid^2)
}
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda - 1 l.v.}
      new_u[i] = glmnet1$coefficients
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 1
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200

    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }})
  
  ite_converge_all[k] = j

}
```

```{r alternating glms - 1 l.v. - updating through constraints -- Chen}

#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(tidyverse)

data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]

df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
  dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))

# projection onto ball of radius c
proc = function(y, c){
  y = as.numeric(y)
  if (sqrt(sum(y^2)) <= c) return(y)
  c * y / sqrt(sum(y^2))
}
    
lv_chen = function(Y, X, K, u_all, max_iter){
  n = nrow(Y)          # 56
  J = ncol(Y)          # 200
  c = 5 * sqrt(K)

  beta_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(X))
  lambda_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u_all))

  # initialize column parameters from Poisson GLMs without latent term
  for (j in 1:J) {
    fit_j = glm.fit(
      y = Y[, j],
      x = cbind(X, u_all), 
      family = poisson(link = "log")
    )
    coef_j = as.matrix(t(fit_j$coefficients))
    beta_all[j, ] = coef_j[1:ncol(X)]    
    lambda_all[j, ] = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1):(ncol(X) + ncol(u_all))]
  }

  loglik = -Inf
  
  beta_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(X)) 
  lambda_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u_all)) 
  u_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = ncol(u_all)) #56 x 1

  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
  ## ---------------------------
  ## (a) ROWS FIRST: update u_i
  ## ---------------------------
    for (i in 1:n) {
      
      # current offset for row i across all columns
      
      # row-wise GLM update
      glm1 = glm.fit(
        y = as.numeric(Y[i, ]),
        x = as.matrix(lambda_all),   # J x 1
        intercept = FALSE,
        family = poisson(link = "log"),
        offset = X[i, ] %*% t(beta_all), # 1 x 200
        start = u_all[i, ],
        control = glm.control(maxit = 1)
      )
      
      u = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))

      u_proj[i, ] = proc(u, sqrt(c^2 - 1))
    }
    
    u_all = u_proj
    
    ## -----------------------------------------
    ## (b) COLUMNS SECOND: update beta_i, lambda_i
    ## -----------------------------------------
    
    X_u = cbind(X, u_all)
    
    for (j in 1:J) {
      
      start_vec = c(beta_all[j, ], lambda_all[j, ])
      
      glm1 = tryCatch({
        glm.fit(
        y = Y[, j],
        x = X_u,
        family = poisson(link = "log"),
        start = start_vec,
        control = glm.control(maxit = 1)
      )}, error = function(e) return(NULL))
      
      #if (!is.null(glm1) && all(is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
        coef_j = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))
      #} else {
        #coef_j = start_vec * 0.8
      #}
      
      beta_j = coef_j[1:ncol(X)]
      lambda_j = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1):(ncol(X) + ncol(u_all))]
      
      comb_j = c(beta_j, lambda_j) #4 x 1
      comb_proj = proc(comb_j, c)
      
      beta_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[1:ncol(X)]
      lambda_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[(ncol(X) + 1):(ncol(X) + ncol(u_all))]
    }
    
    beta_all = beta_proj
    lambda_all = lambda_proj
    
    ## ----------------
    ## likelihood check
    ## ----------------
    
    eta = X %*% t(beta_all) + u_all %*% t(lambda_all) #56 x 200
    eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -10), 10)
    mu = exp(eta)
    
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u_all, log = TRUE)) +
      sum(dpois(Y, lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    
    rel_change = abs(loglik_new - loglik) / (abs(loglik_new))
    if (rel_change < 1e-3) break
    
    loglik = loglik_new
  }
  return(list(Y = Y, beta_all = beta_all, lambda_all = lambda_all, u_all = u_all, mu = mu, loglik = loglik, loglik_new = loglik_new, iter = iter))
} 

ite = 10
time = rep(NA, ite)
sspearson_resid = rep(NA, ite)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_new_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_all = rep(NA, ite)

for (k in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({alg = lv_chen(Y = as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), X = cbind(1, scale(Xenv[, 1]), scale(Xenv[, 2])), K = 1, u_all = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), max_iter = 20)
  })
  
  ite_converge_all[k] = alg$iter
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  
  pred_counts = alg$mu
  pearson_resid = (alg$Y - pred_counts) / sqrt(pred_counts)
  sspearson_resid[k] = sum(pearson_resid^2)
  
  loglik_new_all[k] = alg$loglik_new
  loglik_all[k] = alg$loglik
}

time
sspearson_resid
ite_converge_all
loglik_new_all
loglik_all #why different?

c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
c(mean(sspearson_resid), sqrt(var(sspearson_resid)))
```


```{r alternating glms - 2 l.v. - updating parameters through constraints -- Chen}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)

data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]

df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
  dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))

# projection onto ball of radius c
proc = function(y, c){
  if (any(is.na(y))) return(rep(0, length(y)))
  y = as.numeric(y)
  if (sqrt(sum(y^2)) <= c) return(y)
  c * y / sqrt(sum(y^2))
}

ite = 10
time = rep(NA, ite)
sspearson_resid = rep(NA, ite)
ite_converge_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_new_all = rep(NA, ite)
loglik_all = rep(NA, ite)

for (k in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({lv_chen(Y = as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), X = cbind(1, scale(Xenv[, 1]), scale(Xenv[, 2])), K = 2, u_all = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = diag(2)), max_iter = 30)
  })
  
  ite_converge_all[k] = alg$iter
  time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  
  pred_counts = alg$mu
  pearson_resid = (alg$Y - pred_counts) / sqrt(pred_counts)
  sspearson_resid[k] = sum(pearson_resid^2)
  
  loglik_new_all[k] = alg$loglik_new
  loglik_all[k] = alg$loglik
}

time
sspearson_resid
ite_converge_all
loglik_new_all
loglik_all #why different?

c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
c(mean(sspearson_resid), sqrt(var(sspearson_resid)))
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 1 l.v.}
ite = 10
time7 = rep(NA, ite)
sspearson_resid7 = rep(NA, ite)
j_all5 = rep(NA, ite)

for (k in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # 1 latent variables

  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 4)
  
  N = 20
  K = 1
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
      glmnet3 = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = df_noXenv[, i], intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(c(glmnet3$a0, as.numeric(glmnet3$beta))) #1 x 3, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
    }
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4] #200 x 1
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1
  
    for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
      glmnet3 = glmnet(x = cbind(lambda, rep(0, length(lambda))), y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet3$beta)[1]) #to drop the extra 0 column
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 1
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }}) 
  
  j_all5[k] = j
  time7[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts7 = exp(eta)
  
  pearson_resid7 = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts7)/sqrt(pred_counts7) 
  sspearson_resid7[k] = sum(pearson_resid7^2)
}
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 2 l.v.}
ite = 10
time8 = rep(NA, ite)
sspearson_resid8 = rep(NA, ite)
j_all6 = rep(NA, ite)

for (k in 1:ite){
  time_i = system.time({u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)) # 2 latent variables

  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 5)
  
  N = 20
  K = 1
  loglik = -Inf
  for (j in 1:N){
  
    for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
      glmnet4 = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = df_noXenv[, i], intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      
      beta_lambda[i, ] = t(c(glmnet4$a0, as.numeric(glmnet4$beta))) #1 x 5, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
    }
    beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
    beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
    lambda = beta_lambda[, 4:5] #200 x 2
    
    new_Xenv = cbind(1, Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
    new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 2) #56 x 2
  
    for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
      glmnet4 = glmnet(x = lambda, y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(K))
      new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet4$beta))
    }
    u = new_u #56 x 2
    u
    eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
    mu = exp(eta)
    loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
    if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
    loglik = loglik_new
  }}) 
  
  j_all6[k] = j
  time8[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  pred_counts8 = exp(eta)
  
  pearson_resid8 = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts8)/sqrt(pred_counts8) 
  sspearson_resid8[k] = sum(pearson_resid8^2)
}

time8
sspearson_resid8
j_all6

c(mean(time8), sqrt(var(time8)))
c(mean(sspearson_resid8), sqrt(var(sspearson_resid8)))

```
